/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新首日主线关卡推断首次失败率对比（繁体 CBT vs 新加坡 Android）
口径：用户首次挑战某关后，在同一首日再次挑战同一关，视为“推断首次失败”。
章节 Boss：stage_name_real 以 '-' 拆分后的第 3 段为 '5'；PPT 仅展示章节 Boss。
说明：事件没有明确胜负字段，因此这是重试代理指标，不能当作服务端真实失败结果。
================================================================================
*/
WITH TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name, e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    SELECT '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name, e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON e."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
StageAttempts AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v."#account_id", v.a_rst[1].id ORDER BY v."#event_time") AS attempt_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v."#account_id", v.a_rst[1].id) AS total_attempts
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON c.cohort_name = '繁体CBT' AND v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v."#account_id", v.a_rst[1].id ORDER BY v."#event_time") AS attempt_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v."#account_id", v.a_rst[1].id) AS total_attempts
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON c.cohort_name = '新加坡全量' AND v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
StageNames AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") AS stage_name,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") AS stage_name_real
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name,
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") AS stage_name,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") AS stage_name_real
    FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18203
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
StageAgg AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        stage_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS challenge_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN attempt_num = 1 AND total_attempts >= 2 THEN account_id END) AS inferred_first_fail_users,
        COUNT(*) AS fight_times
    FROM StageAttempts
    WHERE stage_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    a.cohort_name AS "对比组",
    a.stage_id AS "关卡ID",
    COALESCE(n.stage_name, CAST(a.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) AS "关卡名称",
    CONCAT(CAST(a.stage_id AS VARCHAR), '.', COALESCE(n.stage_name, '未命名关卡')) AS "关卡坐标",
    CASE
        WHEN SPLIT(COALESCE(n.stage_name_real, ''), '-')[3] = '5' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS "是否章节Boss",
    a.challenge_users AS "挑战人数",
    a.fight_times AS "挑战次数",
    a.inferred_first_fail_users AS "推断首次失败人数",
    ROUND(a.inferred_first_fail_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.challenge_users, 0), 2) AS "推断首次失败率(%)"
FROM StageAgg a
LEFT JOIN StageNames n ON a.cohort_name = n.cohort_name AND a.stage_id = n.stage_id
ORDER BY "关卡ID", "对比组";
